semantic_fragments.content: Clause 17 - ELECTROMAGNETIC COMPATIBILITY: RISKS associated with items addressed in RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS including electromagnetic phenomena at locations where ME EQUIPMENT or ME SYSTEM is to be used, and introduction of electromagnetic phenomena into environment by ME EQUIPMENT or ME SYSTEM that might degrade performance of other devices, electrical equipment, and systems. Note: Not evaluated in this report; see separate EMC test report.

ANNEX G - PROTECTION AGAINST HAZARDS OF IGNITION OF FLAMMABLE ANESTHETIC MIXTURES: All clauses G.2 through G.3.2 are marked N/A, indicating the equipment is not intended for use with flammable anesthetic mixtures. This includes requirements for CATEGORY AP and APG equipment markings (green-coloured band/circle), location-based safety requirements for flammable mixtures with air, oxygen, or nitrous oxide, and marking requirements per symbols 22 and 23 in Table D.1.

Clause 16.9.2.2: Protective earthing requirements for ME SYSTEM - The impedance between the protective earth pin in the MAINS PLUG and any PROTECTIVELY EARTHED part must not exceed 200 mΩ for each part sharing a MAINS CONNECTION (per 8.6.4). Removal of any single item must not interrupt protective earthing of any other part without simultaneous disconnection of electrical supply. Additional PROTECTIVE EARTH CONDUCTORS can only be detachable with use of a TOOL. All items marked N/A.
